description: Per-session overnight log returns (close->next-open), spot rToken vs matched stock perp, as computed by ballast/overnight.py:overnight_returns from hourly Bitget candles. Same construction ARGUS must use to be scored on identical nights: session date is the CLOSING session (Friday carries the Fri-close->Mon-open window).
units: natural log return (not bp); multiply by 1e4 for bp
